name: Computer Vision
description: From pixels to perception: image processing, CNNs, detection, segmentation, pose, tracking, OCR and vision transformers.

items.title: Stanford CS231n
items.description: The classic university course on CNNs for visual recognition.

items.title: OpenCV-Python Tutorials
items.description: Practical image processing and computer vision with Python.

items.title: YOLOv8 (Ultralytics)
items.description: Real-time object detection documentation and models.

items.title: PyTorch Vision Docs
items.description: Datasets, transforms and model zoo for vision.

items.title: Torchvision Models
items.description: Pretrained model catalog for transfer learning.

items.title: Papers with Code — Vision
items.description: Latest vision methods with code and results.

lessons.title: What Is Computer Vision?
lessons.description: The field, the tasks, and the datasets that drive progress in visual intelligence.

lessons.title: Image Representation
lessons.description: Pixels, channels, color spaces and the tensor layouts every vision library uses.

lessons.title: Image Processing Fundamentals
lessons.description: Convolutions, blur, edges and thresholds — the classic toolbox that still powers pipelines today.

lessons.title: Image Augmentation
lessons.description: Synthesize training variety: flips, rotations, crops and color jitter to make models robust.

lessons.title: Image Classification
lessons.description: The canonical vision task: train a classifier on MNIST/CIFAR and read the results.

lessons.title: CNNs for Vision
lessons.description: Architecture patterns that win on images: receptive fields, pooling, and depth.

lessons.title: Transfer Learning for Vision
lessons.description: Pretrained backbones are the default starting point — swap the head, keep the features.

lessons.title: Object Detection
lessons.description: Bounding boxes and classes: two-stage detectors, single-shot detectors, and YOLO in practice.

lessons.title: Semantic Segmentation
lessons.description: Label every pixel: FCNs, U-Net, and the encoder-decoder design for pixel-level tasks.

lessons.title: Instance Segmentation
lessons.description: Separate each object, not just each class: Mask R-CNN and the mask-head idea.

lessons.title: Pose Estimation
lessons.description: Detect body keypoints and skeletons with heatmap-based and regression approaches.

lessons.title: OpenCV Fundamentals
lessons.description: The industrial workhorse: reading, writing, resizing, drawing, and real-time camera capture.

lessons.title: Feature Detection & Matching
lessons.description: Keypoints and descriptors: SIFT, ORB, and how image matching enables stitching and localization.

lessons.title: Image Registration & Stitching
lessons.description: Combine overlapping images into panoramas and align images across time or sensors.

lessons.title: Video Analysis & Tracking
lessons.description: Optical flow, frame differencing, and object tracking across video streams.

lessons.title: Face Detection & Recognition
lessons.description: Detect faces, embed them into vectors, and recognize identity — and respect the ethics of it.

lessons.title: OCR & Document AI
lessons.description: Turn images of text into machine-readable text: Tesseract, PaddleOCR, and layout understanding.

lessons.title: 3D Vision
lessons.description: Depth, point clouds and stereo: how cameras recover the third dimension.

lessons.title: Vision Transformers (ViT)
lessons.description: Patch the image into tokens and let attention do the rest — the modern alternative to CNNs.

lessons.title: Evaluating Vision Models
lessons.description: Benchmarks, metrics and failure analysis: accuracy, mAP, and per-class audits.

lessons.title: Computer Vision Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course into a plan: pick a specialization, build portfolio projects, and keep shipping.
